text: Education System: Four years. Students who are eligible to obtain a bachelor's degree and undergraduate diploma must successfully complete the prescribed credits delivered by the Major Cultivation Program and pass the undergraduate dissertation. Courses will be available only when the number of students is more than 10. Main Courses: Principles of Economics, International Business, International Trade Affairs, International Commercial Law, International Finance, Foreign Business Correspondence, International Marketing, etc. Comprehensive Chinese, Listening, Spoken Chinese
